shared_elements: upright slab/stela-like format with carved decoration
human-derived figural imagery in the upper zone
dense repeated small symbolic signs arranged over the surface
justification: Both are upright monuments bearing figural imagery in the upper part and a disc motif with repeated small carved signs below, but that is about the extent of the correspondence. A shows a naturalistic narrative scene of slender human figures adoring a rayed disc above many neat horizontal rows of miniature script signs, while B is a massive block-like anthropomorphic figure whose own body carries a few large, deeply cut schematic emblems (curved bands, a plain ring, a broad girdle) with no registers, no rays and no narrative scene.
